verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kommo has an API reference page (kommo-docs-13) and an llms.txt index, but nothing indicates the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. The VoIP mention of 'usage examples' is static documentation, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths all returned 404, so there is no evidence of an interactive explorer.
